nodes.description: Public totalSupply declared in the Token interface contract.
Constant FREEZE_PERIOD = 720 days that must elapse before any LRC can be unlocked.
Address of the LRC ERC20 token held by the icebox contract.
Address of the owner; used as the only authorised caller and as withdrawal recipient.
LRC balance snapshotted at start() and used to derive the monthly unlock amount.
Cumulative amount of LRC already withdrawn; subtracted inside the unlock calculation.
Amount of LRC unlockable per month, computed as lrcInitialBalance/24.
Timestamp when the program was started; drives all time-based unlock logic.
Monotonic counter incremented on each successful withdrawal.
LRCFoundationIceboxContract constructor, validates and stores token address and owner.
start() snapshots the LRC balance, computes monthly unlock and records startTime.
Payable fallback that performs the time-gated LRC withdrawal to the owner.
Internal helper computing the currently unlockable LRC amount.
SafeMath.mul, checked multiplication that asserts against overflow.
SafeMath.div, division helper.
msg.sender, caller identity checked against owner.
block.timestamp (now), mined by the miner and used for all unlock timing.
External call token.transfer(owner, lrcAmount) transferring LRC out of the contract.
Unchecked arithmetic lrcWithdrawn += lrcAmount inside the fallback.
Unchecked subtraction/division/multiplication computing the unlockable amount.
External call Token(lrcTokenAddress).balanceOf(address(this)) inside start().
External call token.balanceOf(address(this)) inside the fallback.
Constructor parameter _lrcTokenAddress.
Constructor parameter _owner.
Parameter _now of calculateLRCUnlockAmount, carrying block.timestamp.
Parameter _balance of calculateLRCUnlockAmount, the contract's token balance.
Parameter a of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter a of SafeMath.div.
Parameter b of SafeMath.div.
Local variable 'token' holding the Token interface instance in the fallback.
Local variable 'balance' holding the result of balanceOf in the fallback.
Local variable 'lrcAmount' in the fallback holding the computed withdrawal amount.
Local variable 'unlockable' inside calculateLRCUnlockAmount.
Named return variable lrcAmount of calculateLRCUnlockAmount.
Local variable c in SafeMath.mul holding the product.
Local variable c in SafeMath.div holding the quotient.

edges.reason: require(msg.sender == owner) enforces owner-only access for privileged functions.
start() can only be called when msg.sender equals owner.
fallback requires msg.sender == owner before any withdrawal.
owner state variable is the recipient of token.transfer, giving owner-controlled payout.
now > startTime + FREEZE_PERIOD is the sole gate for executing the withdrawal.
block.timestamp feeds the unlockable amount arithmetic, making payout miner-influenceable.
now is passed as the _now parameter into the unlock calculation.
startTime is assigned from now in start().
now is supplied to calculateLRCUnlockAmount as the current time reference.
_now parameter is consumed by the unlock computation.
_balance parameter is consumed by the unlock computation.
calculateLRCUnlockAmount produces the unlockable local variable.
Subtraction/division/multiplication result is stored in unlockable.
Fallback performs an external token.transfer call while holding withdrawal accounting state.
External call into the token contract can re-enter the payable fallback.
lrcWithdrawn state variable is read and updated around the external transfer call.
Fallback executes lrcWithdrawn += lrcAmount with unchecked arithmetic.
Unchecked addition writes the lrcWithdrawn state variable.
local lrcAmount is the addend of the unchecked accumulation.
Local token instance is used to invoke transfer.
Local token instance is used to invoke balanceOf.
balanceOf result is stored into the local balance variable.
balance is passed as _balance into calculateLRCUnlockAmount.
balanceOf result initialises lrcInitialBalance.
start() invokes the external balanceOf call.
Fallback invokes the external balanceOf call.
start() writes the lrcInitialBalance state variable.
lrcInitialBalance.div(24) assigns lrcUnlockPerMonth.
start() writes startTime from now, fixing the unlock schedule.
Constructor stores lrcTokenAddress.
Constructor stores the privileged owner address.
_lrcTokenAddress parameter flows into lrcTokenAddress.
_owner parameter flows into the owner state variable.
SafeMath.mul multiplies parameter a.
SafeMath.mul multiplies parameter b.
Checked product is stored in local c of mul.
SafeMath.div divides parameter a.
SafeMath.div divides by parameter b.
Quotient is stored in local c of div.
FREEZE_PERIOD gates the time-based withdrawal in the fallback.
startTime is compared against now in the fallback guard.
startTime is subtracted inside the unlock arithmetic.
lrcUnlockPerMonth multiplies the elapsed month count.
lrcWithdrawn is subtracted from the computed entitlement.
calculateLRCUnlockAmount assigns its named return variable lrcAmount.
Arithmetic result is returned through the named return variable.
lrcTokenAddress is used to build the Token instance for balanceOf in start().
lrcTokenAddress is used to build the Token instance for balanceOf in the fallback.
lrcTokenAddress determines the token contract targeted by transfer.
Returned unlockable amount is assigned to local lrcAmount in the fallback.
Fallback instantiates the Token interface into local token.
Fallback invokes calculateLRCUnlockAmount.
withdrawId is incremented while emitting the Withdrawal event.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only exists to initialise lrcTokenAddress and is fully consumed by the constructor.
Constructor parameter only sets the owner state variable and has no independent behaviour.
_now is a transient argument of calculateLRCUnlockAmount and is absorbed by that function.
_balance is a transient argument used only to cap the returned unlock amount.
Arithmetic operand of SafeMath.mul with no standalone semantics.
Arithmetic operand of SafeMath.mul with no standalone semantics.
Arithmetic operand of SafeMath.div with no standalone semantics.
Arithmetic operand of SafeMath.div with no standalone semantics.
The token local exists only to issue the external transfer/balanceOf calls.
The balance local is a temporary carrier passed into the unlock calculation.
The lrcAmount local is only used as the addend of the lrcWithdrawn accumulation.
unlockable is the direct result of the unchecked unlock arithmetic expression.
Named return variable of calculateLRCUnlockAmount and identical to its result.
Temporary product variable internal to SafeMath.mul.
Temporary quotient variable internal to SafeMath.div.
